action.objective: Complete broad depth-3 coverage of all legal White moves to identify sound developing options and avoid tactical blunders.
action.rationale: Opening position after 3...g6; Black has committed a kingside pawn structure. No analysis has been run yet, so broad coverage is required before selecting any candidate. Black's g6 weakens the light squares and f6/h6, but no concrete tactic exists yet. I will spend at most half the node budget at depth 3 to shortlist sound moves.
